s: Dine ner shehidliq hannokri beshabbat ubo y"z seipim: nokri shehidliq et hanner bishbil yisrael — asur lekol adam lehishtammesh leoro beshabbat, apillu lemi shello hudlaq bishbilo, shehechemiru bezeh chakamim, hoil venaaset melaka gemura shel tora bishbil yisrael beshabbat. Veken im hibir medurat etzim bishbil yisrael — asur lekol adam miyyisrael lehitchammem kenegdah beshabbat. Vaapillu im hannokri nitkavven letobat atzmo, kegon shessekaro hayyisrael veqatzatz lo sakar kak vekak bead kol yom veyom sheyyadliq lo nerot veyabir lo medura, o sheqqatzatz lo bead kol hadlaqa vehadlaqa vehabara vehabara, velo tzivvahu lehadliq ulehabir beshabbat, ella hu oseh meatzmo kede leharbot biskaro — ap al pi ken asur lehanot mimmelakto beshabbat, shehoil vegup hayyisrael yehe neheneh beshabbat miggup hammelaka — hare iqqar hammelaka naaset beshabbat bishbilo, shehare hannokri eno neheneh miggup hammelaka ella missekarah, vehu mitkavven baasiyyat gup hammelaka beshabbat bishbil sheyyehaneh hayyisrael mimmenna beshabbat, nimtza sheasiyyat meleket hashshabbat hi bishbilo kesheyyehaneh mimmenna beshabbat, veyesh ligzor gezera shemma yomar lo laasotah beshabbat bishbil hanaato im yihyeh muttar lo lehanot mimmenna kesheiqqar asiyyatah bishbil hanaato:

Umikkol maqom, lo hitrichu al hayyisrael latzet mibbeto keshemmadliq bo hannokri ner bishbilo middaat atzmo ap al pi sheyyesh lo hanaa meor hanner, raq shello yishtammesh kelum leoro, veken bammedura. Vehu haddin im hu shobet bemalon bebet hannokri — eno tzarik latzet mimmennu keshemmadliq hannokri ner bishbilo, dekevan shehu shobet bo — naasa kebeto vetorach lo latzet mimmennu. Veim rotzeh laasot middat chasidut — yahapok panayv meor hanner leharot sheeno chapetz bo:

Umikkol maqom, im hanner hu shel yisrael — tzarik hu limchot beyado lekattechilla shello yadliqennu bishbilo, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rn"b, veken bimdura meetzim shel yisrael. (Veim lo hishgiach bo vehidliqo — muttar lo lehanot lehishtammesh leoro, ubilbad shello yaarim bimchaato). Veim micha bannokri hamshortav bebeto velo hishgiach bo (ap al pi shemmuttar lo lehishtammesh leor hanner shemmicha bo, mikkol maqom) chayyab hu legaresh mibbeto et hannokri hazzeh sheeno shomea lo umadliq o mabir bishbilo beshabbat. Veap al pi shehu mitkavven letobat atzmo kede leharbot biskaro sheqqatzatz lo bead kol hadlaqa vehabara, vahare zeh keqabbelan sheen tzarik limchot beyado ap sheoseh hammelaka bachapatzim shel yisrael kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom asur lo lehannicho sheyyaaseh bebeto, mippene marit haayin, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Abal im hanner o haetzim shel hannokri — eno tzarik limchot bo kesheoseh middaat atzmo ap al pi shello qatzatz lo sakar, mittaam shennitbaer sham. Vaapillu betok bet yisrael en chosheshim lemarit haayin keshehammelaka naaset bachapatzim shel nokri, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h:

Umikkol maqom, muttar lo limchot bo. Veken muttar limchot benokri shebba lehosip shemen shello bener haddoleq, veen bazeh mishshum kibbuy sheal yede mechaato gorem mehirut hakkibbuy. Ukeshemmicha benokri hammadliq mishshello, ben bebeto ben bebet hannokri velo hishgiach bo — muttar lo lehishtammesh leoro, ubilbad shello yaarim bimchaato:

Vekol zeh keshehidliq bishbil yisrael, abal im hidliq bishbil atzmo o bishbil nokri acher — muttar lekol yisrael lehishtammesh leoro apillu hanner shel hayyisrael, sheen gozerim shemma yomar lannokri sheyyadliq bishbil atzmo o bishbil nokri acher. Veken im hidliq letzorek choleh apillu sheen bo sakkana, o letzorek qetannim sheddinam kecholeh sheen bo sakkana lekol dabar — muttar labberiim lehishtammesh leoro, sheen kan gezera shemma yomar lannokri lehadliq bishbil hacholeh, shehare dabar muttar hu apillu lekattechilla:

Yisreelim venokrim shehesebbu yachad uba nokri vehidliq lahem ner, im rob hammesibba nokrim — muttar lehishtammesh leoro. Veim rubbah yisrael — asur lehishtammesh leoro, shemmin hassetam mitkavven hammadliq letzorek harob. Veim mechetza yisrael umechetza nokrim — gam ken asur, shemmin hassetam hu mekavven letzorek shenehem. Veap im sapeq leezeh mehem madliq — holekim lehachamir besapeq zeh. Vekol zeh keshemmadliq setam, shemmin hassetam kavvanato bishbil hamsubbin, abal im yesh hokacha shemmadliq bishbil atzmo, kegon sheanu roim shehu mishtammesh leorah (miyyad), ap al pi sheharob yisrael — muttar lehishtammesh leorah. Veken im yesh hokacha shemmadliq bishbil nokri acher. Abal im yesh hokacha shemmadliq letzorek yisrael uletzorek nokri, ap al pi sheharob nokrim — asur:

Biqtzat meqomot nahagu rabbim lehaqel baamira lehannokri lehadliq nerot letzorek seudda keshennikbu hannerot vei epshar leekol bachoshek. Veyesh shellimmedu zekut al shello michu beyadam chakamim, lepi shessomekin al mi sheomer shello gazeru al shebut shel amira lenokri bimqom mitzva apillu lomar lo laasot melaka gemura shel tora. Umikkol maqom, im ner echad daluq adayin vikolim leekol etzlo — asur lomar lenokri sheyyadliq od, sheen kan mitzva kol kak lidchot bishbilah shebut shel amira lenokri. (Veim hidliq meatzmo — muttar lehanot mimmennu ap leachar shekkaba harishon, kevan sheoneg shabbat taluy bazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer). Abal kol adam tzarik lehachamir leatzmo shello lomar lenokri lehadliq ner ap al pi sheyyosheb bachoshek veeno yakol leekol seuddat shabbat, lepi sherabbu haomerim shello hittiru shebut bimqom mitzva, ella shebut dishbut, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z, vedibrehem iqqar, lepikak en lehaqel kelal bazeh apillu letzorek gadol, ella sheen limchot behammeqillin, shemmutab sheyyihyu shogegim veal yihyu mezidim:

Abal lomar lannokri sheyyabi lo ner haddaluq kebar bemaqom acher — yesh mattirim apillu im epshar lo bilado, ben ner shel shaava vecheleb, ben ner shel shemen, lepi shettiltul hanner eno asur ella mippene shehu muqtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"t, vekol muqtzeh muttar letaltelo betiltul min hatztzad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a, vekevan shehayyisrael beatzmo haya yakol lehabi hanner lekan behetter betiltul min hatztzad, kegon baachore yadayv, o ben atzile yadayv, vekayyotze bazeh, keshemmebio hannokri beissur betiltul gamur — en bekak kelum, shello aseru laasot al yede nokri beshabbat ella debarim sheen shum hetter leyisrael laasot beatzmo. Veen lehorot hetter zeh ella libne tora, abal leamme haaretz en lehattir, shello yitraggelu baamira lenokri vidammu dabar ledabar veyaqellu yoter:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmebio lekan kede lehanot kan leoro, o mippene shetztzarik lammaqom shehaya hanner omed sham, abal asur letaltel al yede nokri kede lehatznio kede shello yigganeb, lepi shettiltul zeh hu letzorek hanner shehu muqtzeh, veen hetter leyisrael letaltel muqtzeh apillu betiltul min hatztzad keshettiltulo hu bishbil hammuqtzeh atzmo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a. (Veap sheyyitbaer sham shekkol tiltul min hatztzad shehu al yede gupo shello beyadayv yakol letaltelo apillu letzorek hammuqtzeh, ushear tiltul min hatztzad shehaya al yede dabar acher shebbeyadayv en hetter ella keshemmetaltelo letzorek meqomo abal lo keshetztzarik lehishtammesh begup hammuqtzeh, veim ken zeh hanner im yetaltelennu al yede dabar acher shebbeyadayv lo yukal letaltelo kede lehanot meoro kan bemaqom shemmebio, vegam i epshar kelal lahabio al yede hattiltul min hatztzad shel dabar acher shebbeyadayv, veim yetaltelennu al yede gupo kegon baachore yadayv o ben atzile yadayv vekayyotze bazeh yakol letaltelo ap bishbil shello yigganeb — ap al pi ken en lehattir lomar lenokri sheyyatzniennu, lepi sheotam hammattirim tiltul kedarko al yede nokri kesheyyesh hetter leyisrael min hatztzad — hem soberim sheap al yede gupo en hetter letaltel letzorek hammuqtzeh atzmo, ella kede lehishtammesh begup hammuqtzeh, o mippene shetztzarik limqomo, veen lehaqel yoter mimmah shehem atzmam meqillim):

Im omer adam leabdo uleshipchato lelek immo lachutz ballayla umadliqim hanner meatzman, ap al pi sheggam hem tzerikin lener zeh umitkavvenim letzorek atzman bilbad — en zeh niqra letzorek nokri, kevan sheiqqar hahalika hi letzorek yisrael ubishbilo, ulepikak (tzarik limchot bam shello yadliqu im hanner shello, veim lo micha bahem vehidliquhu) — asur lelek immahem lachutz ad sheyyannichu hanner babbayit, shello yehaneh meor hanner shehudlaq bishbil halikato, apillu hanner shel nokri. (Veim micha bam velo hishgichu bo vehidliqu — muttar lehishtammesh leoro im eno maarim, kemo shennitbaer lemala):

Abal ner shemmadleqet hashshipcha lehadiach kele akila leoro, ap al pi shehadacha zo hi letzorek hayyisrael — en hadlaqa zo niqra bishbil yisrael, hoil veen gup hayyisrael neheneh (minner zeh) (mehadacha zo), ella shekkelim shello mudachim vehi chayyebet lahadicham — letzorkah hi madleqet, veen tzarik limchot bah, umuttar lehishtammesh leor ner zeh:

Vekol zeh bener, abal bimdura sheasaah nokri apillu letzorko bilbad, o letzorek choleh apillu sheyyesh bo sakkana — asur lebari lehitchammem kenegdah, gezera shemma yarbeh hannokri etzim bishbilo im yihyeh muttar lo lehitchammem bah. Veenah doma lener, sheen sham chashash sheyyarbeh bishbilo, shenner leechad ner lemea, mah sheen ken bimdura, shekkol mah shemmitrabbim bene adam hammitchammemim bah tzarik leharbot bah etzim leharchibah. Abal im chimmem et bet hachorep letzorko o letzorek choleh — muttar lebari lelek mibbet haqqayitz lebet hachorep lehitchammem bo, sheen lachush shemma yarbeh lechammemo bishbilo, shechimmum leechad chimmum lemea. Veyesh mattirin apillu bimdura, veen gozerim shemma yarbeh bishbilo, mippene sheap im lo haya marbeh bishbilo haya neheneh qetzat mehammedura. Veap sheal yede ribbuy haetzim neheneh mimmennu berevach — en tosepet hanaa zo keday ligzor bishbilah shemma yomar lo leharbot bishbilo etzim. Veap im asa hannokri medura qetanna letzorko bilbad, o letzorek choleh, veachar kak ba zeh lehitchammem kenegdah vehosip hannokri etzim bishbilo middaat atzmo — en hosapa zo osarto lehitchammem sham, kevan shehaya yakol lehitchammem sham qetzat ap belo hosapa zo. Veken im hayeta hammedura doleqet mibbeod yom ubeshabbat hosip bah hannokri etzim bishbil yisrael — muttar lehitchammem kenegdah. (Raq shellekattechilla tzarik lizzaher bekol zeh limchot bo im haetzim shel yisrael, kemo shennitbaer). Uleet hatztzorek yesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Umikkol maqom, im kebar kalu etzim shehudlequ mibbeod yom o letzorek nokri o letzorek choleh, veen doleqim bimdura zo ella haetzim shehosip beshabbat bishbil yisrael — asur lehitchammem kenegdah. Veken im haya ner doleq mibbeod yom o letzorek nokri o letzorek choleh uba nokri vehosip od ner bishbil yisrael — en hetter lehishtammesh leoro ella beod shehanner harishon doleq, abal leachar shekkaba harishon asur lehishtammesh leor hashsheni. Veken im hosip shemen bener haddoleq — en hetter lehishtammesh leoro ella ad bikde sheyyikleh hashshemen shehaya bener battechilla, veachar kak asur. Veyesh choleqin al zeh umattirin ben bimdura, ben bener, ben behosapat hashshemen, ap al pi shehem shel yisrael, dekevan shebbitchilla kesheasa hannokri haissur bishbil hayyisrael haya muttar lehanot mimmennu — lo yatza midde hettero leolam, ap leachar shekkalu etzim harishonim, o hanner harishon, o hashshemen harishon. Ubimqom tzorek gadol, dehaynu sheoneg shabbat taluy bezeh — yesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel:

Vekol haissurim shennitbaaru bechimmum keneged hammedura o bet hachorep enan ella baaratzot sheenan qarot, abal baaratzot haqqarot kemo bimdinot ellu — muttar lomar lenokri laasot medura bishbil yisrael beyom shehaqqor gadol, veken lomar lo lechammem et bet hachorep, lepi shehakkol hem kecholim etzel haqqor haggadol. Abal beyom sheen haqqor gadol kol kak, im en lo qetannim shemmitztaarim harbeh — asur lomar lenokri laasot medura o lechammem bet hachorep. Veim oseh medura meatzmo meatze yisrael — tzarik limchot beyado. Veim lo micha — asur lehitchammem kenegdah. Veim chimmem bet hachorep meatzmo bishbil yisrael meatze yisrael — asur likkanes bo kede lehitchammem. Abal im hu dar bo — en tzarik latzet mimmennu:

Im sakar hannokri sheyyassiqennu lo bekol yom vayom kol yemot hachorep, vehissiqo gam beshabbat kesheen haqqor gadol — hare zeh keoseh meatzmo veen tzarik latzet mibbeto, ella shellekattechilla tzarik limchot bo:

Vehannohagim hetter ap beyom sheen haqqor gadol, mikkol maqom en mochin beyadam, shemmutab sheyyihyu shogegim veal yihyu mezidim, veap beyom shehaqqor gadol en lechammem bet hachorep shene peamim beyom hashshabbat, ki day bammeh shehissiq hattannur paam rishon babboqer. Umikkol maqom, hakkol lepi haqqor ulepi bet hachorep im mamshik hachom zeman merubbeh, vehechakam enayv berosho:
